definition: νύμφη, -ης, ἡ  [in LXX chiefly for כַּלָּה ;] __1. cl., a bride, young wife, young woman: Mat.25:1, WH, mg., Jhn.3:29, Rev.18:23 21:2, 9 22:17.  __2. As frequently in LXX (Gen.38:11, al., for כַּלָּה;  __(a) bride;  __(b) daughter-in-law) and in MGr. (νύφφη, νύφη), a daughter-in-law: Mat.10:35, Luk.12:53.† (AS)
